thesis: The speaker describes his grandfather as a world-famous magician who focused on making grandchildren happy and his father as an entrepreneur who identified market arbitrage opportunities, such as the duty spread on raw versus finished gold in Dubai. The father's business eventually failed when competitors eliminated the arbitrage spread, turning the venture into a 'Me Too' proposition.
